failure: The instrumented semantics package reached Go's 10-minute alarm while running TestTemporalExecutorUnsafeQueuedChildScaleClosesHeldBarriers/trial-01; its partial profile reported 58.5% and is not admissible.
observation: Every other topology package passed. The semantics process had accumulated all unit tests, the complete frozen semantics and recovery real-path suites, recovery-scale checks, and then a separate three-trial scale regression under one package alarm. The scale test itself was still progressing when the aggregate alarm fired.
inference: A single package process is the wrong failure boundary for instrumenting multiple independent real Temporal suites. The alarm measures accumulated suite duration, not one scenario's liveness, and discards otherwise complete coverage.
falsifier: Every partitioned package process must pass independently with the identical coverpkg set; the atomic merger must accept all complete profiles; and the combined result must still meet 80% without using the partial default profile.
correction: Run non-semantics packages together, semantics unit tests under -short, each default real integration test in a separate package process, and each v5 high-scale shape in a separate package process. Merge only the named complete profiles. The ordinary go test -race ./... command remains unchanged and still runs the full default suite.
